name: cowdogmoo
description: CowDogMoo marketplace: squad agents for code review, testing, documentation, and security audits, the shared skills they depend on, and the cowdogmoo-music skills.

plugins.name: squad-agents
plugins.description: Language-specific code review, testing, documentation, and security-audit agents. Installing it also installs the squad-skills plugin they load.

plugins.name: squad-skills
plugins.description: The skills squad agents load: language review, testing, documentation, and security knowledge bases, the shared review and security-audit loops, comment scrubbing, LLM-tell detection, coverage orchestration, doc-comment discovery loops, and test-writer discipline.

plugins.name: cowdogmoo-music
plugins.description: Quad Cortex Neural Capture workflow, Guitar Pro tablature authoring, riff transcription, and Ableton Live screen control. Independent of the agents.
